scope: Latest expanded868 fixed checkpoints; no optimizer, collection, parameter/threshold selection. New posthoc visualization only.
boundaries: Each80episodes all6executed-after boundaries1..6. Root state0 excluded. Observed posterior updated along actual public observation/action history, no coldreset perboundary.
latent: ObjectAug.history posts[t][:,:3,:],128-dimensional object h_i afterobserve. Context c128 stored separately, never mixed as same kind of point. Readout consumes[h_i,c], so h-only map need not separate all readout errors.
sampling: All160episodes*6boundaries*3objects, balanced1440points percohort and960perobject identity; no outcome/label-based sampling.

preprocessing.standardization: Per dimension jointdev+holdout visualization mean/std, clampstd1e-8
preprocessing.transductive_viz_only: Joint PCA/tSNE is posthoc visualization, not model fitting orout-of-sample testevaluation.

stability.diagnostics: k15neighbour overlap, trustworthiness. Alternative coordinates retained; main alwaysp30.

figures: One shared coordinate set permodel across4panels:truthIn/Held/other,split,identity,Inerroroutlines. Seed1projectedindependently; never compare absolute axes acrossmodels.
upload_scope: Only newplots andnewderivative CSV/scripts/README bundle. No original frames,data,models,oldreports orlatent npz.
